title: The Dirac fluid in graphene is the laboratory anchor

statements.text: Ultra-clean graphene near charge neutrality realizes relativistic hydrodynamic closure in a lab, so it is the arena in which the continuity-first account must turn into measured transport predictions, such as the ratio of coherence time to dissipation time.

sources.quote: relativistic hydrodynamic closure is experimentally realised in a finite quantum material.
Within the present manuscript these are not claimed as new predictions.
